ChatGPT Record Mode vs Meetily: Local-First Meeting Recording (No Cloud, No Account)

ChatGPT Record Mode uploads your audio to OpenAI servers and requires a paid ChatGPT account. Meetily records and transcribes locally on your device, with no account required and a free Community Edition.
✅ AUDIO STAYS ON DEVICE VS UPLOADED TO OPENAI
✅ NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED VS CHATGPT PLUS / TEAM

children.text: Why People Look for a Local Alternative to ChatGPT Record Mode
ChatGPT Record Mode is convenient, but every recording leaves your device. Meetily keeps the audio local.
Where Your Audio Goes: Local vs Cloud
The core difference is architectural. ChatGPT Record Mode sends audio to OpenAI. Meetily keeps it on your machine.
You choose: local AI or BYOK
What ChatGPT Record Mode Does Well, and Where Meetily Differs
Both tools transcribe and summarize meetings. The honest difference is where your data lives and what you have to pay (and sign up) for to get there.
ChatGPT Record Mode: Great if you already pay for ChatGPT

If you already have ChatGPT Plus / Team and you're fine with OpenAI processing your audio, Record Mode is genuinely convenient - one app, one subscription, summaries live in your chat history. The tradeoff is that every recording goes to OpenAI.
Meetily: Audio never leaves your device

Meetily transcribes locally on Windows and macOS using on-device Whisper or Parakeet models. With the Community Edition, nothing leaves your machine - no audio, no transcript, no account. Pricing: free Community Edition, or $10/user/month billed annually for Pro.

ChatGPT Record Mode is tied to OpenAI models. Meetily lets you pick: local Ollama / built-in model for full privacy or bring-your-own key (Claude, OpenAI, Groq). The model that suits your privacy and quality needs - not the vendor's.
ChatGPT Record Mode needs an internet connection to upload audio. Meetily Community runs entirely offline once installed, so it works on flights, in secure rooms, and on flaky hotel wifi.

Meetily ships with local Whisper / Parakeet models that handle 99+ languages without sending audio off-device. ChatGPT Record Mode also supports broad language coverage, but transcription happens in the cloud.

You can install Meetily, record a meeting, and never create an account. ChatGPT Record Mode requires an active ChatGPT Plus subscription tied to your OpenAI account. If you cancel, you lose access to the recording flow.
How to Use Meetily as a Local-First Alternative
Keep your ChatGPT subscription if you want - Meetily slots in next to it for the recording itself.
Download Meetily for Windows or macOS. No account, no signup. The Community Edition is free and transcribes 100% locally on your machine.
Meetily captures system audio directly, with no meeting bot. Audio and the resulting transcript stay on your machine. Use any meeting platform - Zoom, Meet, Teams, WebEx.
Pick a summary path: local Ollama / built-in model (nothing leaves) or bring-your-own key (including OpenAI / ChatGPT). With BYOK, only transcript text is sent off-device - never audio.
ChatGPT Record Mode vs Meetily: FAQ

children.a: Yes. OpenAI's ChatGPT Record Mode (rolled out to Plus, Pro, Team, and Enterprise users) lets you start a recording inside the ChatGPT app and have it transcribed and summarized by ChatGPT. The audio is sent to OpenAI's servers for transcription and summarization. It works as a built-in feature of ChatGPT, not as a separate desktop recorder.

children.q: Where does ChatGPT Record Mode store my audio?
children.a: ChatGPT Record Mode uploads your audio to OpenAI's servers for processing. The resulting transcript and summary are saved to your ChatGPT chat history, which lives in OpenAI's cloud and is tied to your account. The audio is processed off-device, so the raw recording leaves your machine.

children.q: Do I need a ChatGPT account to use Record Mode?
children.a: Yes. ChatGPT Record Mode requires a signed-in ChatGPT account on a paid plan (Plus is $20/month, with Team and Enterprise on different rates). Without an account and an active subscription, you can't access the feature.

children.q: Is the transcript shared with OpenAI?
children.a: Yes - the transcript and summary are generated by OpenAI's models and stored in your ChatGPT history on OpenAI's infrastructure. Whether the data is used to improve OpenAI models depends on your account-level data controls (consumer vs Team/Enterprise plans have different defaults). If you want the transcript and audio to stay on your device, you need a local-first tool, not a cloud one.

children.q: Can I use ChatGPT Record Mode offline?
children.a: No. ChatGPT Record Mode requires an internet connection because the audio is uploaded to OpenAI for transcription and summarization. If your connection drops or you're working in a no-network environment, the feature won't work.

children.q: What's a private alternative to ChatGPT Record Mode?
children.a: Meetily is a local-first alternative. The Community Edition runs transcription entirely on your device using local Whisper or Parakeet models, with no account, no cloud upload, and no subscription. Meetily Pro lets you bring your own API key for summaries, but audio always stays local - only transcript text is ever sent off-device, and only if you choose to use an external provider. Meetily supports 99+ languages on Windows and macOS.

children.q: Does Meetily require an OpenAI key?
children.a: No. Meetily Community runs fully on-device with no keys at all. If you want to summarize with an external model you can bring your own API key (Claude, OpenAI, Groq), but neither is required. The default path is 100% local.

children.q: Can Meetily summarize with ChatGPT after the fact?
children.a: Yes. Meetily separates recording from summarization on purpose. You record locally with Meetily, then choose how to summarize: local AI (Ollama or the built-in model) or bring-your-own key (including OpenAI / ChatGPT). So you can still get a ChatGPT-quality summary without sending the audio itself to OpenAI - only the transcript text.
